query:
SELECT v.id, v.modelo, v.matricula, v.categoria, v.status, v.fleet_vehicle_id, fv.nombre as fleet_name, fv.marca as fleet_marca
FROM vehicles v
LEFT JOIN fleet_vehicles fv ON v.fleet_vehicle_id = fv.id
WHERE fv.marca = 'Porsche' OR v.modelo ILIKE '%porsche%' OR v.modelo ILIKE '%carrera%' OR v.modelo ILIKE '%cayenne%' OR v.modelo ILIKE '%992%'
ORDER BY v.modelo
